name: When is the best time to install interior trim during a home renovation?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to install interior trim during a home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The optimal time to install interior trim during a home renovation is typically after major construction work, drywall installation, and initial priming of walls, but before final painting or flooring installation. This sequence allows the trim to be installed onto stable surfaces and provides an opportunity to fill nail holes and caulk seams before the final coat of paint. Installing trim before finished flooring helps avoid potential damage to new floors and allows the trim to be cut precisely to meet the subfloor, ensuring a tight fit with the finished floor. Maine Results, Inc. advises coordinating trim installation with other trades to maintain project flow and prevent rework.
acceptedAnswer.description: Install interior trim after drywall and priming, but before final painting or flooring, to ensure stable surfaces and a clean finish.
